name: Interpret the meaning of dreams and quotes
description: Users asked the assistant to interpret the symbolic meaning of specific dreams and analyze the deeper implications of philosophical, literary, or personal quotes. Many requests focused on decoding surreal imagery in personal experiences, such as dreams or sensory observations, or clarifying the intent behind ambiguous statements and cultural sayings.
